According to the tipster, the F35 devices will be launching in India either at the end of this month or at the beginning of September, most likely during the first week of September. title: Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro is official with a 6,000mAh battery, triple camera setup
description: The Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro has made its debut in India with a triple-rear camera setup, a 6,000mAh battery, and 6 years of guaranteed software support. Samsung had revealed all the key features of the handset last week and also confirmed its pricing. The phone will be available for purchase via Flipkart starting August 8 in Aurora Green and Alpha Black color options. As a launch offer, the phone will be sold at a starting price tag of INR 23,999 ($250) for the base 6GB/128GB variant. Meanwhile, the 8GB/128GB and 8GB/256GB variants will be offered at INR 27,999 ($295) and INR 32,999...

title: Samsung will axe one of the Galaxy S27 Ultra's cameras
description: According to two separate sources, Samsung is considering dropping the dated 10MP 3x telephoto camera on the Galaxy S27 Ultra. The sensor has been around since the Galaxy S21 Ultra, and it seems it will finally retire next year. One of the sources specifically states that there won't be a substitute for the 3x telephoto camera. Only the 200MP main unit, the 50MP 5x telephoto shooter and the 50MP ultrawide camera will remain. description: Oppo is all set to unveil the A7 Pro Max on August 4. In the run-up to the launch, the company has detailed the phone's complete camera setup and shared a video showcasing its durability. While Oppo had previously confirmed that the A7 Pro Max will feature a 50MP primary rear camera and a 50MP front-facing camera, the company has now revealed the identity of the second rear sensor. Unfortunately, it's just a 2MP depth sensor, meaning there's no ultrawide or telephoto camera on offer. Oppo has also shared a video on Weibo highlighting the A7 Pro Max's durability. title: The Galaxy S27 Pro will reportedly get a 12MP telephoto camera
description: Samsung is rumored to introduce a new Pro model with the Galaxy S27 lineup, which is expected to debut in early 2027. While several details about the Galaxy S27 Pro have already leaked, a new report now offers information on the handset's telephoto camera. According to a report from ET News, citing industry sources, the Galaxy S27 Pro will feature a 12MP telephoto camera with support for 3x optical zoom. The Galaxy S27 Pro is expected to slot below the Galaxy S27 Ultra in Samsung's upcoming flagship lineup. Rumors suggest it will feature a 200MP primary camera and a 50MP ultrawide...

Last week, the company revealed that the K100 Pro Max will feature a 6.9-inch display. title: vivo S2 full specs, Galaxy S27 Pro and Ultra batteries leak, Week 31 in review
description: July is now over and done, so let's recap its final week. The vivo S2's full specifications leaked ahead of its expected August 6 launch in India. The phone will feature a 6.83-inch 1.5K 120Hz curved AMOLED display, a MediaTek Dimensity 7360 chipset, a 50MP Sony IMX852 main camera, a 2MP secondary sensor, and a 32MP selfie camera. The phone has a massive 7,050mAh battery with 44W charging, and IP68/IP69 water and dust resistance. description: Last week’s poll asked which one of Samsung’s new foldables has caught your attention, and we have a clear winner. description: WhatsApp is apparently aware of the fact that a lot of its users are facing a problem with clutter in their main chat list, especially due to having a lot of separate threads with messages from large businesses like banks or airlines. So, according to a new report, WhatsApp is now testing what it thinks is a solution to this problem. Messages from large businesses will automatically be moved into a new "Offers & Updates" folder after a set number of hours have passed since they were received. description: A few days ago, a report from Korea suggested that Samsung was going to launch eight flagship devices next year, including four foldables - the Flip9, Fold9, Fold9 Ultra, the TriFold 2.
